Below is a short, ready-to-forward message your benefits lead can send to employees. I put the source for each statement directly after that statement (so you can forward without editing). Do you want this formatted with a subject line and signature (yes/no)? ([cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/shingles/hcp/vaccine-considerations/index.html?utm_source=openai))

Recommended shingles (herpes zoster) vaccination schedule — key points

- Which vaccine and who should get it: The CDC’s recommended vaccine is the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV, brand name Shingrix); it is routinely recommended for all immunocompetent adults aged 50 years and older and for adults aged 19 years and older who are or will be immunodeficient or immunosuppressed because of disease or therapy. ([cdc.gov](https://www.cdc.gov/shingles/hcp/vaccine-considerations/index.html?utm_source=openai)
